task: Debug Transform to SMART goal button network error

findings.error_description: Network connection failed when Transform to SMART goal button is pressed
findings.actual_root_cause: Authentication error misreported as network error

technical_analysis.button_location: GoalInput component - Transform into SMART Goal button
technical_analysis.flow: GoalInput -> App.handleGoalSubmit -> SmartGoalDisplay -> translateGoal() -> API call
technical_analysis.error_mapping: Frontend converts 401/502 responses to network connection failed message

user_configuration_required.requirement: User must provide valid OpenAI API key
user_configuration_required.validation: Key must start with sk- and be at least 20 characters

resolution.immediate_fix: User needs to configure valid OpenAI API key in ApiConfig component
resolution.technical_fix: Frontend error handling should distinguish between network and authentication errors
resolution.user_experience: Error message should indicate API key required, not network connection failed

reproduction_steps: 2. Skip API configuration or provide invalid key
3. Enter a goal and click Transform into SMART Goal button
4. Observe Network connection failed error (actually auth error)
verification_steps: 1. Configure valid OpenAI API key in ApiConfig
3. Confirm successful API response and goal transformation
